extracted.intended_audience: R package authors, reviewers, and editors interested in rOpenSci's software peer review
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and high-level standards for rOpenSci's volunteer-based software peer review program that evaluates scientific R packages; describes aims, process characteristics, scope, roles, and tooling. Useful for prospective submitters, reviewers, and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review process characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: rOpenSci’s peer review process should be transparent, constructive, non-adversarial, and open.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program brings together aspects of scientific peer review and open-source code review to create a review process characterized by transparency, constructive feedback, and a non-adversarial tone; openness (public interaction/artefacts) is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goals of review: quality, reliability, maintainability
rubrics_metrics.description: The peer review aims to improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of scientific R packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews are intended to raise the technical and practical standards of packages so they are robust for scientific use and long-term maintenance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer expertise and composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Recruit expert developers and users to provide feedback on submitted packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are drawn from both developers and domain users so that reviews combine software engineering and domain-specific perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderation and mentorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide careful moderation and mentorship to foster a productive and inclusive review environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors moderate interactions and provide mentorship to ensure reviews are constructive, inclusive, and that authors can make progress; this is part of the program design to support contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code diagnostics informed by R expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply code diagnostics based on rOpenSci’s deep experience in the R language to assess packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: rOpenSci uses its accumulated R expertise and diagnostic tools to identify issues in code, style, or practices specific to the R ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tooling and automation to support reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Use chatbot-supported interactions and automation on open platforms to create a smooth review experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program leverages automation and tooling (including chatbots) to streamline communication and review workflows on open platforms; tooling is considered part of delivering an efficient review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and submission eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review focuses on scientific applications and accepts packages related to two review streams: scientific data lifecycles and statistical algorithms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only packages whose primary purpose is scientific (falling in the stated streams) are within scope; authors should consult the development guide and the statistical software guide for details on scope and suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors manage incoming submissions and ensure progress of reviews and submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors volunteer to oversee flow, coordinate reviewers, moderate discussions, and help shepherd packages through the review process toward completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors create, submit, and improve their packages in response to review feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are expected to actively participate: prepare package submissions, respond constructively to reviewer comments, and iteratively improve code and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers examine software source code and documentation as part of the evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are expected to inspect code and docs, provide actionable feedback, and collaborate with editors and authors to improve the package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curation and community building
rubrics_metrics.description: Use peer review to curate a suite of high-quality packages and to build a community of developers and users that supports long-term development and maintenance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond individual package improvements, the program seeks to assemble a curated collection of dependable scientific packages and foster a supportive community for sustained maintenance.
